props.name: columns
props.description: Column count, or one per breakpoint: `{ base: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }`. Ignored when `minItemWidth` is set.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: Fit as many columns as there is room for, each at least this wide — a number is pixels, a string any CSS length. The grid then answers to its own width rather than the viewport’s, which is what a card list inside a sidebar layout wants.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cells, on the spacing scale — 4 is 16px.

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of cells inside their rows.

props.name: children
props.description: The cells. Wrap one in GridItem to span columns or rows.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render — `ul` for a list of cards, `section`.
